  1626	// RPC is used to make a local RPC call
  1627	func (s *Server) RPC(ctx context.Context, method string, args interface{}, reply interface{}) error {
  1628		remoteAddr, _ := RemoteAddrFromContext(ctx)
  1629		codec := &inmemCodec{
  1630			method:     method,
  1631			args:       args,
  1632			reply:      reply,
  1633			sourceAddr: remoteAddr,
  1634		}
  1635	
  1636		// Enforce the RPC limit.
  1637		//
  1638		// "client" metric path because the internal client API is calling to the
  1639		// internal server API. It's odd that the same request directed to a server is
  1640		// recorded differently. On the other hand this possibly masks the different
  1641		// between regular client requests that traverse the network and these which
  1642		// don't (unless forwarded). This still seems most reasonable.
  1643		metrics.IncrCounter([]string{"client", "rpc"}, 1)
  1644		if !s.rpcLimiter.Load().(*rate.Limiter).Allow() {
  1645			metrics.IncrCounter([]string{"client", "rpc", "exceeded"}, 1)
  1646			return structs.ErrRPCRateExceeded
  1647		}
  1648		if err := s.rpcServer.ServeRequest(codec); err != nil {
  1649			return err
  1650		}
  1651		return codec.err
  1652	}

  1654	// SnapshotRPC dispatches the given snapshot request, reading from the streaming
  1655	// input and writing to the streaming output depending on the operation.
  1656	func (s *Server) SnapshotRPC(args *structs.SnapshotRequest, in io.Reader, out io.Writer,
  1657		replyFn structs.SnapshotReplyFn) error {
  1658	
  1659		// Enforce the RPC limit.
  1660		//
  1661		// "client" metric path because the internal client API is calling to the
  1662		// internal server API. It's odd that the same request directed to a server is
  1663		// recorded differently. On the other hand this possibly masks the different
  1664		// between regular client requests that traverse the network and these which
  1665		// don't (unless forwarded). This still seems most reasonable.
  1666		metrics.IncrCounter([]string{"client", "rpc"}, 1)
  1667		if !s.rpcLimiter.Load().(*rate.Limiter).Allow() {
  1668			metrics.IncrCounter([]string{"client", "rpc", "exceeded"}, 1)
  1669			return structs.ErrRPCRateExceeded
  1670		}
  1671	
  1672		// Perform the operation.
  1673		var reply structs.SnapshotResponse
  1674		snap, err := s.dispatchSnapshotRequest(args, in, &reply)
  1675		if err != nil {
  1676			return err
  1677		}
  1678		defer func() {
  1679			if err := snap.Close(); err != nil {
  1680				s.logger.Error("Failed to close snapshot", "error", err)
  1681			}
  1682		}()
  1683	
  1684		// Let the caller peek at the reply.
  1685		if replyFn != nil {
  1686			if err := replyFn(&reply); err != nil {
  1687				return err
  1688			}
  1689		}
  1690	
  1691		// Stream the snapshot.
  1692		if out != nil {
  1693			if _, err := io.Copy(out, snap); err != nil {
  1694				return fmt.Errorf("failed to stream snapshot: %v", err)
  1695			}
  1696		}
  1697		return nil
  1698	}

    37	func (s *Server) setupGRPCInterfaces(config *Config, deps Deps) error {
    38		// A server has 5 different gRPC interfaces
    39		//
    40		// * External - This is the main public gRPC network listener. This
    41		//      is an actual *grpc.Server that we have listening on both the
    42		//      grpc and grpc_tls ports. Generally this interface will not be
    43		//      used by the server itself. All services which are intended
    44		//      to be public APIs must be registered to this interface. This
    45		//      interface is created outside of the server in the agent code
    46		//      and then passed to the NewServer constructor. Some services
    47		//      like xDS and DNS get registered outside of the server code.
    48		//
    49		// * Internal / Multiplexed - Our internal_rpc port uses yamux and
    50		//      various byte prefixes to multiplex different protocols over
    51		//      the single connection. One of the multiplexed protocols is
    52		//      gRPC. gRPC in this fashion works using a custom net.Listener
    53		//      implementation that receives net.Conns to be handled through
    54		//      a channel. When a new yamux session is opened which produces
    55		//      a yamux conn (which implements the net.Conn interface), the
    56		//      connection is then sent to the custom listener. Then the
    57		//      standard grpc.Server.Serve method can accept the conn from
    58		//      the listener and operate on it like any other standard conn.
    59		//      Historically, the external gRPC interface was optional and
    60		//      so all services which needed leader or DC forwarding had to
    61		//      be exposed on this interface in order to guarantee they
    62		//      would be available. In the future, an external gRPC interface
    63		//      likely will be required and the services which need registering
    64		//      to the multiplexed listener will be greatly reduced. In the
    65		//      very long term we want to get rid of this internal multiplexed
    66		//      port/listener and instead have all component communications use
    67		//      gRPC natively. For now though, if your service will need to
    68		//      RECEIVE forwarded requests then it must be registered to this
    69		//      interface.
    70		//
    71		// * In-Process - For routines running on the server we don't want them
    72		//      to require network i/o as that will incur a lot of unnecessary
    73		//      overhead. To avoid that we are utilizing the `grpchan` library
    74		//      (github.com/fullstorydev/grpchan) and its `inprocgrpc` package.
    75		//      The library provides the `inprocgrpc.Channel` which implements
    76		//      both the `grpc.ServiceRegistrar` and `grpc.ClientConnInterface`
    77		//      interfaces. Services get registered to the `Channel` and then
    78		//      gRPC service clients can be created with the `Channel` used
    79		//      for the backing `ClientConn`. When a client then uses the
    80		//      `Invoke` or `NewStream` methods on the `Channel`, the `Channel`
    81		//      will lookup in its registry of services to find the service's
    82		//      server implementation and then have the standard
    83		//      grpc.MethodDesc.Handler function handle the request. We use
    84		//      a few variants of the in-process gRPC Channel. For now all
    85		//      these channels are created and managed in server code but we
    86		//      may need to move these into the higher level agent setup.
    87		//
    88		//      * Insecure + Unsafe - The insecure + unsafe gRPC Channel has
    89		//           services registered to it that wont do typical ACL
    90		//           resolution. Instead when the service resolves ACL tokens
    91		//           a resolver is used which always grants unrestricted
    92		//           privileges. Additionally, this "unsafe" variant DOES
    93		//           NOT clone resources as they pass through the channel. Care
    94		//           Must be taken to note mutate the data passed through the
    95		//           Channel or else we could easily cause data race related
    96		//           or consistency bugs.
    97		//
    98		//      * Insecure + Safe - Similar to the Insecure + Unsafe variant,
    99		//           ACL resolution always provides an authorizer with unrestricted
   100		//           privileges. However, this interface is concurrency/memory safe
   101		//           in that protobuf messages passing through the interface are
   102		//           cloned so that the client is free to mutate those messages
   103		//           once the request is complete. All services registered to the
   104		//           Unsafe variant should also be registered to this interface.
   105		//
   106		//      * Secure + Safe - This Channel will do typical ACL resolution from
   107		//           tokens and will clone protobuf messages that pass through. This
   108		//           interface will be useful for something like the HTTP server that
   109		//           is crafting the gRPC requests from a user request and wants to
   110		//           assume no implicit privileges by the nature of running on the
   111		//           server. All services registered to the insecure variants should
   112		//           also be registered to this interface. Additionally other services
   113		//           that correspond to user requests should also be registered to this
   114		//           interface.
   115		//
   116		//      Currently there is not a need for a Secure + Unsafe variant. We could
   117		//      add it if needed in the future.
   118	
   119		recoveryOpts := agentmiddleware.PanicHandlerMiddlewareOpts(s.loggers.Named(logging.GRPCAPI))
   120	
   121		inprocLabels := []metrics.Label{{
   122			Name:  "server_type",
   123			Value: "in-process",
   124		}}
   125	
   126		statsHandler := agentmiddleware.NewStatsHandler(metrics.Default(), inprocLabels)
   127	
   128		// TODO(inproc-grpc) - figure out what to do with rate limiting inproc grpc. If we
   129		// want to rate limit in-process clients then we are going to need a unary interceptor
   130		// to do that. Another idea would be to create rate limited clients which can be given
   131		// to controllers or other internal code so that the whole Channel isn't limited but
   132		// rather individual consumers of that channel.
   133	
   134		// Build the Insecure + Unsafe gRPC Channel
   135		s.insecureUnsafeGRPCChan = new(inprocgrpc.Channel).
   136			// Bypass the in-process gRPCs cloning functionality by providing
   137			// a Cloner implementation which doesn't actually clone the data.
   138			// Note that this is only done for the Unsafe gRPC Channel and
   139			// all the Safe variants will utilize the default cloning
   140			// functionality.
   141			WithCloner(inprocgrpc.CloneFunc(func(in any) (any, error) {
   142				return in, nil
   143			})).
   144			WithServerUnaryInterceptor(middleware.ChainUnaryServer(
   145				recovery.UnaryServerInterceptor(recoveryOpts...),
   146				statsHandler.Intercept,
   147			)).
   148			WithServerStreamInterceptor(middleware.ChainStreamServer(
   149				recovery.StreamServerInterceptor(recoveryOpts...),
   150				agentmiddleware.NewActiveStreamCounter(metrics.Default(), inprocLabels).Intercept,
   151			))
   152	
   153		// Build the Insecure + Safe gRPC Channel
   154		s.insecureSafeGRPCChan = new(inprocgrpc.Channel).
   155			WithServerUnaryInterceptor(middleware.ChainUnaryServer(
   156				recovery.UnaryServerInterceptor(recoveryOpts...),
   157				statsHandler.Intercept,
   158			)).
   159			WithServerStreamInterceptor(middleware.ChainStreamServer(
   160				recovery.StreamServerInterceptor(recoveryOpts...),
   161				agentmiddleware.NewActiveStreamCounter(metrics.Default(), inprocLabels).Intercept,
   162			))
   163	
   164		// Build the Secure + Safe gRPC Channel
   165		s.secureSafeGRPCChan = new(inprocgrpc.Channel).
   166			WithServerUnaryInterceptor(middleware.ChainUnaryServer(
   167				recovery.UnaryServerInterceptor(recoveryOpts...),
   168				statsHandler.Intercept,
   169			)).
   170			WithServerStreamInterceptor(middleware.ChainStreamServer(
   171				recovery.StreamServerInterceptor(recoveryOpts...),
   172				agentmiddleware.NewActiveStreamCounter(metrics.Default(), inprocLabels).Intercept,
   173			))
   174	
   175		// create the internal multiplexed gRPC interface
   176		s.internalGRPCHandler = agentgrpc.NewHandler(deps.Logger, config.RPCAddr, nil, s.incomingRPCLimiter)
   177	
   178		return nil
   179	}

   181	func (s *Server) setupGRPCServices(config *Config, deps Deps) error {
   182		// Register the resource service with the in-process registrars WITHOUT AUTHORIZATION
   183		err := s.registerResourceServiceServer(
   184			deps.Registry,
   185			resolver.DANGER_NO_AUTH{},
   186			s.insecureUnsafeGRPCChan,
   187			s.insecureSafeGRPCChan)
   188		if err != nil {
   189			return err
   190		}
   191	
   192		// Register the resource service with all other registrars other
   193		// than the internal/multiplexed interface. Currently there is
   194		// no need to forward resource service RPCs and therefore the
   195		// service doesn't need to be available on that interface.
   196		err = s.registerResourceServiceServer(
   197			deps.Registry,
   198			s.ACLResolver,
   199			s.secureSafeGRPCChan,
   200			s.internalGRPCHandler,
   201			s.externalGRPCServer,
   202		)
   203		if err != nil {
   204			return err
   205		}
   206	
   207		// The ACL grpc services get registered with all "secure" gRPC interfaces
   208		err = s.registerACLServer(
   209			s.secureSafeGRPCChan,
   210			s.externalGRPCServer,
   211			s.internalGRPCHandler,
   212		)
   213		if err != nil {
   214			return err
   215		}
   216	
   217		// register the Connect CA service on all "secure" interfaces
   218		err = s.registerConnectCAServer(
   219			s.secureSafeGRPCChan,
   220			s.externalGRPCServer,
   221			s.internalGRPCHandler,
   222		)
   223		if err != nil {
   224			return err
   225		}
   226	
   227		// Initializing the peering backend must be done before
   228		// creating any peering servers. There is other code which
   229		// calls methods on this and so the backend must be stored
   230		// on the Server type. In the future we should investigate
   231		// whether we can not require the backend in that other code.
   232		s.peeringBackend = NewPeeringBackend(s)
   233	
   234		// register the peering service on the external gRPC server only
   235		// As this service is only ever accessed externally there is
   236		// no need to register it on the various in-process Channels
   237		s.peerStreamServer, err = s.registerPeerStreamServer(
   238			config,
   239			s.externalGRPCServer,
   240			s.internalGRPCHandler,
   241		)
   242		if err != nil {
   243			return err
   244		}
   245	
   246		// register the peering service on the internal interface only. As
   247		// the peering gRPC service is a private API its only ever accessed
   248		// via the internalGRPCHandler with an actual network conn managed
   249		// by the Agents GRPCConnPool.
   250		err = s.registerPeeringServer(
   251			config,
   252			s.internalGRPCHandler,
   253		)
   254		if err != nil {
   255			return err
   256		}
   257	
   258		// Register the Operator service on all "secure" interfaces. The
   259		// operator service is currently only accessed via the
   260		// internalGRPCHandler but in the future these APIs are likely to
   261		// become part of our "public" API and so it should be exposed on
   262		// more interfaces.
   263		err = s.registerOperatorServer(
   264			config,
   265			deps,
   266			s.internalGRPCHandler,
   267			s.secureSafeGRPCChan,
   268			s.externalGRPCServer,
   269		)
   270		if err != nil {
   271			return err
   272		}
   273	
   274		// register the stream subscription service on the multiplexed internal interface
   275		// if stream is enabled.
   276		if config.RPCConfig.EnableStreaming {
   277			err = s.registerStreamSubscriptionServer(
   278				deps,
   279				s.internalGRPCHandler,
   280			)
   281			if err != nil {
   282				return err
   283			}
   284		}
   285	
   286		// register the server discovery service on all "secure" interfaces other
   287		// than the multiplexed internal interface. This service is mainly consumed
   288		// by the consul-server-connection-manager library which is used by various
   289		// other system components other than the agent.
   290		err = s.registerServerDiscoveryServer(
   291			s.ACLResolver,
   292			s.secureSafeGRPCChan,
   293			s.externalGRPCServer,
   294		)
   295		if err != nil {
   296			return err
   297		}
   298	
   299		// register the server discovery service on the insecure in-process channels.
   300		// Currently, this is unused but eventually things such as the peering service
   301		// should be refactored to consume the in-memory service instead of hooking
   302		// directly into an the event publisher and subscribing to specific events.
   303		err = s.registerServerDiscoveryServer(
   304			resolver.DANGER_NO_AUTH{},
   305			s.insecureUnsafeGRPCChan,
   306			s.insecureSafeGRPCChan,
   307		)
   308		if err != nil {
   309			return err
   310		}
   311	
   312		// register the data plane service on the external gRPC server only. This
   313		// service is only access by dataplanes and at this time there is no need
   314		// for anything internal in Consul to use the service. If that changes
   315		// we could register it on the in-process interfaces as well.
   316		err = s.registerDataplaneServer(
   317			s.externalGRPCServer,
   318		)
   319		if err != nil {
   320			return err
   321		}
   322	
   323		// register the configEntry service on the internal interface only. As
   324		// it is only accessed via the internalGRPCHandler with an actual network
   325		// conn managed  by the Agents GRPCConnPool.
   326		err = s.registerConfigEntryServer(
   327			s.internalGRPCHandler,
   328		)
   329		if err != nil {
   330			return err
   331		}
   332	
   333		// enable grpc server reflection for the external gRPC interface only
   334		reflection.Register(s.externalGRPCServer)
   335	
   336		return s.setupEnterpriseGRPCServices(config, deps)
   337	}

   381	func (s *Server) registerPeerStreamServer(config *Config, registrars ...grpc.ServiceRegistrar) (*peerstream.Server, error) {

   383			panic("peeringBackend is required during construction")
   384		}
   385	
   386		srv := peerstream.NewServer(peerstream.Config{
   387			Backend:        s.peeringBackend,
   388			GetStore:       func() peerstream.StateStore { return s.FSM().State() },
   389			Logger:         s.loggers.Named(logging.GRPCAPI).Named(logging.PeerStream),
   390			ACLResolver:    s.ACLResolver,

   392			ConnectEnabled: s.config.ConnectEnabled,
   393			ForwardRPC: func(info structs.RPCInfo, fn func(*grpc.ClientConn) error) (bool, error) {
   394				// Only forward the request if the dc in the request matches the server's datacenter.
   395				if info.RequestDatacenter() != "" && info.RequestDatacenter() != config.Datacenter {
   396					return false, fmt.Errorf("requests to generate peering tokens cannot be forwarded to remote datacenters")
   397				}
   398				return s.ForwardGRPC(s.grpcConnPool, info, fn)
   399			},
   400		})
   401	
   402		for _, reg := range registrars {
   403			srv.Register(reg)
   404		}
   405	
   406		return srv, nil

   151	// delegate defines the interface shared by both
   152	// consul.Client and consul.Server.
   153	type delegate interface {
   154		// Leave is used to prepare for a graceful shutdown.
   155		Leave() error
   156	
   157		// AgentLocalMember is used to retrieve the LAN member for the local node.
   158		AgentLocalMember() serf.Member
   159	
   160		// LANMembersInAgentPartition returns the LAN members for this agent's
   161		// canonical serf pool. For clients this is the only pool that exists. For
   162		// servers it's the pool in the default segment and the default partition.
   163		LANMembersInAgentPartition() []serf.Member
   164	
   165		// LANMembers returns the LAN members for one of:
   166		//
   167		// - the requested partition
   168		// - the requested segment
   169		// - all segments
   170		//
   171		// This is limited to segments and partitions that the node is a member of.
   172		LANMembers(f consul.LANMemberFilter) ([]serf.Member, error)
   173	
   174		// GetLANCoordinate returns the coordinate of the node in the LAN gossip
   175		// pool.
   176		//
   177		// - Clients return a single coordinate for the single gossip pool they are
   178		//   in (default, segment, or partition).
   179		//
   180		// - Servers return one coordinate for their canonical gossip pool (i.e.
   181		//   default partition/segment) and one per segment they are also ancillary
   182		//   members of.
   183		//
   184		// NOTE: servers do not emit coordinates for partitioned gossip pools they

  1979	// PauseSync is used to pause anti-entropy while bulk changes are made. It also
  1980	// sets state that agent-local watches use to "ride out" config reloads and bulk
  1981	// updates which might spuriously unload state and reload it again.
  1982	func (a *Agent) PauseSync() {
  1983		// Do this outside of lock as it has it's own locking
  1984		a.sync.Pause()
  1985	
  1986		// Coordinate local state watchers
  1987		a.syncMu.Lock()
  1988		defer a.syncMu.Unlock()

  1995	func (a *Agent) ResumeSync() {

  1997		// Pause/Resume in nested way during a reload and AddService. We only want to
  1998		// trigger local state watchers if this Resume call actually started sync back
  1999		// up again (i.e. was the last resume on the stack). We could check that
  2000		// separately with a.sync.Paused but that is racey since another Pause call
  2001		// might be made between our Resume and checking Paused.
  2002		resumed := a.sync.Resume()
  2003	
  2004		if !resumed {
  2005			// Return early so we don't notify local watchers until we are actually
  2006			// resumed.
  2007			return
  2008		}
  2009	
  2010		// Coordinate local state watchers
  2011		a.syncMu.Lock()
  2012		defer a.syncMu.Unlock()
  2013	
  2014		if a.syncCh != nil {
  2015			close(a.syncCh)

   122	func validateId(id *pbresource.ID, errorPrefix string) error {

   127		if err := resource.ValidateName(id.Name); err != nil {
   128			return status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "%s.name invalid: %v", errorPrefix, err)
   129		}

   131		// Better UX: Allow callers to pass in nil tenancy.  Defaulting and inheritance of tenancy
   132		// from the request token will take place further down in the call flow.

   136				Namespace: "",
   137			}
   138		}
   139

   142				return status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "%s.tenancy.partition invalid: %v", errorPrefix, err)

    68	func (s *Server) GetResolvedExportedServices(
    69		ctx context.Context,
    70		req *pbconfigentry.GetResolvedExportedServicesRequest,
    71	) (*pbconfigentry.GetResolvedExportedServicesResponse, error) {
    72	
    73		if err := s.Backend.EnterpriseCheckPartitions(req.Partition); err != nil {
    74			return nil, grpcstatus.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, err.Error())
    75		}
    76	
    77		options, err := external.QueryOptionsFromContext(ctx)
    78		if err != nil {
    79			return nil, err
    80		}
    81	
    82		var resp *pbconfigentry.GetResolvedExportedServicesResponse
    83		var emptyDCSpecificRequest structs.DCSpecificRequest
    84	
    85		handled, err := s.ForwardRPC(&readRequest{options, emptyDCSpecificRequest}, func(conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
    86			var err error
    87			resp, err = pbconfigentry.NewConfigEntryServiceClient(conn).GetResolvedExportedServices(ctx, req)
    88			return err
    89		})
    90		if handled || err != nil {
    91			return resp, err
    92		}
    93	
    94		defer metrics.MeasureSince([]string{"configentry", "get_resolved_exported_services"}, time.Now())
    95	
    96		var authzCtx acl.AuthorizerContext
    97		entMeta := structs.DefaultEnterpriseMetaInPartition(req.Partition)
    98	
    99		authz, err := s.Backend.ResolveTokenAndDefaultMeta(options.Token, entMeta, &authzCtx)
   100		if err != nil {
   101			return nil, err
   102		}
   103	
   104		if err := authz.ToAllowAuthorizer().MeshReadAllowed(&authzCtx); err != nil {
   105			return nil, err
   106		}
   107	
   108		res := &pbconfigentry.GetResolvedExportedServicesResponse{}
   109		meta := structs.QueryMeta{}
   110		err = blockingquery.Query(s.FSMServer, &options, &meta, func(ws memdb.WatchSet, store *state.Store) error {
   111			idx, exportedSvcs, err := store.ResolvedExportedServices(ws, entMeta)
   112			if err != nil {
   113				return err
   114			}
   115	
   116			meta.SetIndex(idx)
   117	
   118			res.Services = exportedSvcs
   119			return nil
   120		})
   121		if err != nil {
   122			return nil, fmt.Errorf("error executing exported services blocking query: %w", err)
   123		}
   124	
   125		header, err := external.GRPCMetadataFromQueryMeta(meta)
   126		if err != nil {
   127			return nil, fmt.Errorf("could not convert query metadata to gRPC header")
   128		}
   129		if err := grpc.SendHeader(ctx, header); err != nil {
   130			return nil, fmt.Errorf("could not send gRPC header")
   131		}
   132	
   133		return res, nil
   134	}

    20	
    21	// Server implements a StateChangeSubscriptionServer for accepting SubscribeRequests,
    22	// and sending events to the subscription topic.
    23	type Server struct {
    24		Backend Backend
    25		Logger  Logger
    26	}
    27	
    28	func NewServer(backend Backend, logger Logger) *Server {
    29		return &Server{Backend: backend, Logger: logger}
    30	}
    31	
    32	type Logger interface {
    33		Trace(msg string, args ...interface{})
    34		With(args ...interface{}) hclog.Logger
    35	}
    36	
    37	var _ pbsubscribe.StateChangeSubscriptionServer = (*Server)(nil)
    38	
    39	type Backend interface {
    40		ResolveTokenAndDefaultMeta(token string, entMeta *acl.EnterpriseMeta, authzContext *acl.AuthorizerContext) (acl.Authorizer, error)
    41		Forward(info structs.RPCInfo, f func(*grpc.ClientConn) error) (handled bool, err error)
    42		Subscribe(req *stream.SubscribeRequest) (*stream.Subscription, error)
    43	}
    44	
    45	func (h *Server) Subscribe(req *pbsubscribe.SubscribeRequest, serverStream pbsubscribe.StateChangeSubscription_SubscribeServer) error {
    46		logger := newLoggerForRequest(h.Logger, req)
    47		handled, err := h.Backend.Forward(req, forwardToDC(req, serverStream, logger))
    48		if handled || err != nil {
    49			return err
    50		}
    51	
    52		logger.Trace("new subscription")
    53		defer logger.Trace("subscription closed")
    54	
    55		entMeta := req.EnterpriseMeta()
    56		authz, err := h.Backend.ResolveTokenAndDefaultMeta(req.Token, &entMeta, nil)
    57		if err != nil {
    58			return err
    59		}
    60	
    61		subReq, err := state.PBToStreamSubscribeRequest(req, entMeta)
    62		if err != nil {
    63			return status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, err.Error())
    64		}
    65	
    66		sub, err := h.Backend.Subscribe(subReq)
    67		if err != nil {
    68			return err
    69		}
    70		defer sub.Unsubscribe()
    71	
    72		ctx := serverStream.Context()
    73		elog := &eventLogger{logger: logger}
    74		for {
    75			event, err := sub.Next(ctx)
    76			switch {
    77			case errors.Is(err, stream.ErrSubForceClosed):
    78				logger.Trace("subscription reset by server")
    79				return status.Error(codes.Aborted, err.Error())
    80			case errors.Is(err, stream.ErrACLChanged):
    81				logger.Trace("ACL change occurred; re-authenticating")
    82				_, authzErr := h.Backend.ResolveTokenAndDefaultMeta(req.Token, &entMeta, nil)
    83				if authzErr != nil {
    84					return authzErr
    85				}
    86				// Otherwise, abort the stream so the client re-subscribes.
    87				return status.Error(codes.Aborted, err.Error())
    88			case err != nil:
    89				return err
    90			}
    91	
    92			if !event.Payload.HasReadPermission(authz) {
    93				continue
    94			}
    95	
    96			elog.Trace(event)
    97	
    98			// TODO: This conversion could be cached if needed
    99			e := event.Payload.ToSubscriptionEvent(event.Index)
   100			if err := serverStream.Send(e); err != nil {
   101				return err
   102			}
   103		}
   104	}
   105	
   106	func forwardToDC(
   107		req *pbsubscribe.SubscribeRequest,
   108		serverStream pbsubscribe.StateChangeSubscription_SubscribeServer,
   109		logger Logger,
   110	) func(conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
   111		return func(conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
   112			logger.Trace("forwarding to another DC")
   113			defer logger.Trace("forwarded stream closed")
   114	
   115			client := pbsubscribe.NewStateChangeSubscriptionClient(conn)
   116			streamHandle, err := client.Subscribe(serverStream.Context(), req)
   117			if err != nil {
   118				return err
   119			}
   120	
   121			for {
   122				event, err := streamHandle.Recv()
   123				if err != nil {
   124					return err
   125				}
   126				if err := serverStream.Send(event); err != nil {
   127					return err
   128				}
   129			}
   130		}
   131	}

    22	// Coordinate manages queries and updates for network coordinates.
    23	type Coordinate struct {
    24		// srv is a pointer back to the server.
    25		srv *Server
    26	
    27		logger hclog.Logger
    28	
    29		// updates holds pending coordinate updates for the given nodes. This is
    30		// keyed by partition/node:segment so we can get a coordinate for each
    31		// segment for servers, and we only track the latest update per
    32		// partition/node:segment.
    33		updates map[string]*structs.CoordinateUpdateRequest
    34	
    35		// updatesLock synchronizes access to the updates map.
    36		updatesLock sync.Mutex
    37	}
    38	
    39	// NewCoordinate returns a new Coordinate endpoint.
    40	func NewCoordinate(srv *Server, logger hclog.Logger) *Coordinate {
    41		c := &Coordinate{
    42			srv:     srv,
    43			logger:  logger.Named(logging.Coordinate),
    44			updates: make(map[string]*structs.CoordinateUpdateRequest),
    45		}
    46	
    47		go c.batchUpdate()
    48		return c
    49	}
    50	
    51	// batchUpdate is a long-running routine that flushes pending coordinates to the
    52	// Raft log in batches.
    53	func (c *Coordinate) batchUpdate() {
    54		for {
    55			select {
    56			case <-time.After(c.srv.config.CoordinateUpdatePeriod):
    57				if err := c.batchApplyUpdates(); err != nil {
    58					c.logger.Warn("Batch update failed", "error", err)
    59				}
    60			case <-c.srv.shutdownCh:
    61				return
    62			}
    63		}
    64	}
    65	
    66	// batchApplyUpdates applies all pending updates to the Raft log in a series of
    67	// batches.
    68	func (c *Coordinate) batchApplyUpdates() error {
    69		// Grab the pending updates and release the lock so we can still handle
    70		// incoming messages.
    71		c.updatesLock.Lock()
    72		pending := c.updates
    73		c.updates = make(map[string]*structs.CoordinateUpdateRequest)
    74		c.updatesLock.Unlock()
    75	
    76		// Enforce the rate limit.
    77		limit := c.srv.config.CoordinateUpdateBatchSize * c.srv.config.CoordinateUpdateMaxBatches
    78		size := len(pending)
    79		if size > limit {
    80			c.logger.Warn("Discarded coordinate updates", "number_discarded", size-limit)
    81			size = limit
    82		}
    83	
    84		// Transform the map into a slice that we can feed to the Raft log in
    85		// batches.
    86		i := 0
    87		updates := make(structs.Coordinates, size)
    88		for _, update := range pending {
    89			if i >= size {
    90				break
    91			}
    92	
    93			update.Normalize()
    94	
    95			updates[i] = &structs.Coordinate{
    96				Node:      update.Node,
    97				Segment:   update.Segment,
    98				Coord:     update.Coord,
    99				Partition: update.PartitionOrEmpty(),
   100			}
   101			i++
   102		}
   103	
   104		// Apply the updates to the Raft log in batches.
   105		for start := 0; start < size; start += c.srv.config.CoordinateUpdateBatchSize {
   106			end := start + c.srv.config.CoordinateUpdateBatchSize
   107			if end > size {
   108				end = size
   109			}
   110	
   111			// We set the "safe to ignore" flag on this update type so old
   112			// servers don't crash if they see one of these.
   113			t := structs.CoordinateBatchUpdateType | structs.IgnoreUnknownTypeFlag
   114	
   115			slice := updates[start:end]
   116			_, err := c.srv.raftApply(t, slice)
   117			if err != nil {
   118				return err
   119			}
   120		}

    30	// Apply does an upsert of the given config entry.
    31	func (c *ConfigEntry) Apply(args *structs.ConfigEntryRequest, reply *bool) error {
    32		if err := c.srv.validateEnterpriseRequest(args.Entry.GetEnterpriseMeta(), true); err != nil {
    33			return err
    34		}
    35	
    36		err := gateWriteToSecondary(args.Datacenter, c.srv.config.Datacenter, c.srv.config.PrimaryDatacenter, args.Entry.GetKind())
    37		if err != nil {
    38			return err
    39		}
    40	
    41		// Ensure that all config entry writes go to the primary datacenter. These will then
    42		// be replicated to all the other datacenters.
    43		args.Datacenter = c.srv.config.PrimaryDatacenter
    44	
    45		if done, err := c.srv.ForwardRPC("ConfigEntry.Apply", args, reply); done {
    46			return err
    47		}
    48		defer metrics.MeasureSince([]string{"config_entry", "apply"}, time.Now())
    49	
    50		entMeta := args.Entry.GetEnterpriseMeta()
    51		authz, err := c.srv.ResolveTokenAndDefaultMeta(args.Token, entMeta, nil)
    52		if err != nil {
    53			return err
    54		}
    55	
    56		if err := c.preflightCheck(args.Entry.GetKind()); err != nil {
    57			return err
    58		}
    59	
    60		// Normalize and validate the incoming config entry as if it came from a user.
    61		// Ensure Normalize is called before Validate for accurate validation
    62		if err := args.Entry.Normalize(); err != nil {
    63			return err
    64		}
    65		if err := args.Entry.Validate(); err != nil {
    66			return err
    67		}
    68	
    69		// Log any applicable warnings about the contents of the config entry.
    70		if warnEntry, ok := args.Entry.(structs.WarningConfigEntry); ok {
    71			warnings := warnEntry.Warnings()
    72			for _, warning := range warnings {
    73				c.logger.Warn(warning)
    74			}
    75		}
    76	
    77		if err := args.Entry.CanWrite(authz); err != nil {
    78			return err
    79		}
    80	
    81		if args.Op != structs.ConfigEntryUpsert && args.Op != structs.ConfigEntryUpsertCAS {
    82			args.Op = structs.ConfigEntryUpsert
    83		}
    84	
    85		if skip, err := c.shouldSkipOperation(args); err != nil {
    86			return err
    87		} else if skip {
    88			*reply = true
    89			return nil
    90		}
    91	
    92		resp, err := c.srv.raftApply(structs.ConfigEntryRequestType, args)
    93		if err != nil {
    94			return err
    95		}
    96		if respBool, ok := resp.(bool); ok {
    97			*reply = respBool
    98		}
    99	
   100		return nil
   101	}

    23	func (c *DiscoveryChain) Get(args *structs.DiscoveryChainRequest, reply *structs.DiscoveryChainResponse) error {
    24		// Exit early if Connect hasn't been enabled.
    25		if !c.srv.config.ConnectEnabled {
    26			return ErrConnectNotEnabled
    27		}
    28	
    29		if done, err := c.srv.ForwardRPC("DiscoveryChain.Get", args, reply); done {
    30			return err
    31		}
    32		defer metrics.MeasureSince([]string{"discovery_chain", "get"}, time.Now())
    33	
    34		// Fetch the ACL token, if any.
    35		entMeta := args.GetEnterpriseMeta()
    36		var authzContext acl.AuthorizerContext
    37		authz, err := c.srv.ResolveTokenAndDefaultMeta(args.Token, entMeta, &authzContext)
    38		if err != nil {
    39			return err
    40		}
    41		if err := authz.ToAllowAuthorizer().ServiceReadAllowed(args.Name, &authzContext); err != nil {
    42			return err
    43		}
    44	
    45		if args.Name == "" {
    46			return fmt.Errorf("Must provide service name")
    47		}
    48	
    49		evalDC := args.EvaluateInDatacenter
    50		if evalDC == "" {
    51			evalDC = c.srv.config.Datacenter
    52		}
    53	
    54		var (
    55			priorHash uint64
    56			ranOnce   bool
    57		)
    58		return c.srv.blockingQuery(
    59			&args.QueryOptions,
    60			&reply.QueryMeta,
    61			func(ws memdb.WatchSet, state *state.Store) error {
    62				req := discoverychain.CompileRequest{
    63					ServiceName:            args.Name,
    64					EvaluateInNamespace:    entMeta.NamespaceOrDefault(),
    65					EvaluateInPartition:    entMeta.PartitionOrDefault(),
    66					EvaluateInDatacenter:   evalDC,
    67					OverrideMeshGateway:    args.OverrideMeshGateway,
    68					OverrideProtocol:       args.OverrideProtocol,
    69					OverrideConnectTimeout: args.OverrideConnectTimeout,
    70				}
    71				index, chain, entries, err := state.ServiceDiscoveryChain(ws, args.Name, entMeta, req)
    72				if err != nil {
    73					return err
    74				}
    75	
    76				// Generate a hash of the config entry content driving this
    77				// response. Use it to determine if the response is identical to a
    78				// prior wakeup.
    79				newHash := chain.GetHash()

    81				if ranOnce && priorHash == newHash {

    85					// is desirable
    86					return errNotChanged
    87				} else {
    88					priorHash = newHash
    89					ranOnce = true
    90				}
    91	
    92				reply.Index = index
    93				reply.Chain = chain
    94	
    95				if entries.IsEmpty() {
    96					return errNotFound
    97				}

    36	// preApply does all the verification of a KVS update that is performed BEFORE

    40		// Verify the entry.
    41		if dirEnt.Key == "" && op != api.KVDeleteTree {
    42			return false, fmt.Errorf("Must provide key")
    43		}
    44	
    45		// Apply the ACL policy if any, and validate operation.
    46		// enumcover:api.KVOp
    47		switch op {
    48		case api.KVDeleteTree:
    49			var authzContext acl.AuthorizerContext
    50			dirEnt.FillAuthzContext(&authzContext)
    51	
    52			if err := authz.ToAllowAuthorizer().KeyWritePrefixAllowed(dirEnt.Key, &authzContext); err != nil {
    53				return false, err
    54			}
    55	
    56		case api.KVGet, api.KVGetTree, api.KVGetOrEmpty:
    57			// Filtering for GETs is done on the output side.
    58	
    59		case api.KVCheckSession, api.KVCheckIndex:
    60			// These could reveal information based on the outcome
    61			// of the transaction, and they operate on individual
    62			// keys so we check them here.
    63			var authzContext acl.AuthorizerContext
    64			dirEnt.FillAuthzContext(&authzContext)
    65	
    66			if err := authz.ToAllowAuthorizer().KeyReadAllowed(dirEnt.Key, &authzContext); err != nil {
    67				return false, err
    68			}
    69	
    70		case api.KVCheckNotExists, api.KVUnlock, api.KVLock, api.KVCAS, api.KVDeleteCAS, api.KVDelete, api.KVSet:
    71			var authzContext acl.AuthorizerContext
    72			dirEnt.FillAuthzContext(&authzContext)
    73	
    74			if err := authz.ToAllowAuthorizer().KeyWriteAllowed(dirEnt.Key, &authzContext); err != nil {
    75				return false, err
    76			}
    77		default:
    78			return false, fmt.Errorf("unknown KV operation: %s", op)

    96			}
    97		}
    98

    36	// DatacenterJoinAddresses will return all the strings suitable for usage in
    37	// retry join operations to connect to the LAN or LAN segment gossip pool.
    38	func (b autoConfigBackend) DatacenterJoinAddresses(partition, segment string) ([]string, error) {
    39		members, err := b.Server.LANMembers(LANMemberFilter{
    40			Segment:   segment,
    41			Partition: partition,
    42		})
    43		if err != nil {
    44			if segment != "" {
    45				return nil, fmt.Errorf("Failed to retrieve members for segment %s: %w", segment, err)
    46			}
    47			return nil, fmt.Errorf("Failed to retrieve members for partition %s: %w", acl.PartitionOrDefault(partition), err)
    48		}
    49	
    50		var joinAddrs []string
    51		for _, m := range members {
    52			if ok, _ := metadata.IsConsulServer(m); ok {
    53				serfAddr := net.TCPAddr{IP: m.Addr, Port: int(m.Port)}
    54				joinAddrs = append(joinAddrs, serfAddr.String())
    55			}
    56		}
    57	
    58		return joinAddrs, nil
    59	}

    61	// CreateACLToken will create an ACL token from the given template
    62	func (b autoConfigBackend) CreateACLToken(template *structs.ACLToken) (*structs.ACLToken, error) {
    63		// we have to require local tokens or else it would require having these servers use a token with acl:write to make a
    64		// token create RPC to the servers in the primary DC.
    65		if !b.Server.LocalTokensEnabled() {
    66			return nil, fmt.Errorf("Agent Auto Configuration requires local token usage to be enabled in this datacenter: %s", b.Server.config.Datacenter)
    67		}
    68	
    69		newToken := *template
    70	
    71		// generate the accessor id
    72		if newToken.AccessorID == "" {
    73			accessor, err := lib.GenerateUUID(b.Server.checkTokenUUID)
    74			if err != nil {
    75				return nil, err
    76			}
    77	
    78			newToken.AccessorID = accessor
    79		}
    80	
    81		// generate the secret id
    82		if newToken.SecretID == "" {
    83			secret, err := lib.GenerateUUID(b.Server.checkTokenUUID)
    84			if err != nil {
    85				return nil, err
    86			}
    87	
    88			newToken.SecretID = secret
    89		}
    90	
    91		newToken.CreateTime = time.Now()
    92	
    93		req := structs.ACLTokenBatchSetRequest{
    94			Tokens: structs.ACLTokens{&newToken},
    95			CAS:    false,
    96		}
    97	
    98		// perform the request to mint the new token
    99		if _, err := b.Server.raftApplyMsgpack(structs.ACLTokenSetRequestType, &req); err != nil {
   100			return nil, err
   101		}
   102	
   103		// return the full token definition from the FSM
   104		_, token, err := b.Server.fsm.State().ACLTokenGetByAccessor(nil, newToken.AccessorID, &newToken.EnterpriseMeta)
   105		return token, err
   106	}

    68	func (b *PeeringBackend) GetTLSMaterials(generatingToken bool) (string, []string, error) {

    72			}
    73			if b.srv.config.GRPCTLSPort <= 0 && !b.srv.tlsConfigurator.GRPCServerUseTLS() {

    89		for _, r := range roots.Roots {
    90			caPems = append(caPems, lib.EnsureTrailingNewline(r.RootCert))
    91		}

    38	func (h *raftHandle) DialLeader() (*grpc.ClientConn, error) {
    39		leaderAddr, _ := h.s.raft.LeaderWithID()
    40		if leaderAddr == "" {
    41			return nil, errors.New("leader unknown")
    42		}
    43	
    44		dc := h.s.config.Datacenter
    45		tlsCfg := h.s.tlsConfigurator
    46	
    47		return grpc.Dial(string(leaderAddr),
    48			// TLS is handled in the dialer below.
    49			grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials()),
    50	
    51			// This dialer negotiates a connection on the multiplexed server port using
    52			// our type-byte prefix scheme (see Server.handleConn for other side of it).
    53			grpc.WithContextDialer(func(ctx context.Context, addr string) (net.Conn, error) {
    54				var d net.Dialer
    55				conn, err := d.DialContext(ctx, "tcp", addr)
    56				if err != nil {
    57					return nil, err
    58				}
    59	
    60				if tlsCfg.UseTLS(dc) {
    61					if _, err := conn.Write([]byte{byte(pool.RPCTLS)}); err != nil {
    62						conn.Close()
    63						return nil, err
    64					}
    65	
    66					tc, err := tlsCfg.OutgoingRPCWrapper()(dc, conn)
    67					if err != nil {
    68						conn.Close()
    69						return nil, err
    70					}
    71					conn = tc
    72				}
    73	
    74				if _, err := conn.Write([]byte{byte(pool.RPCRaftForwarding)}); err != nil {
    75					conn.Close()
    76					return nil, err
    77				}
    78				return conn, nil
    79			}),
    80		)
    81	}

    35	
    36	func (s *v1ServiceExportsShim) Start(ctx context.Context) {
    37		logger := s.s.logger.Named(logging.V2ExportsShim)
    38	
    39		// TODO replace this with a proper supervisor.
    40		for ctx.Err() == nil {
    41			err := subscribeToExportedServicesEvents(ctx, logger, s.s.publisher, s.eventCh)
    42	
    43			if err != nil {
    44				logger.Warn("encountered an error while streaming exported services", "error", err)
    45				select {
    46				case <-time.After(time.Second):
    47				case <-ctx.Done():
    48					return
    49				}
    50			} else {
    51				return
    52			}
    53		}
    54	}
    55	
    56	func subscribeToExportedServicesEvents(ctx context.Context, logger hclog.Logger, publisher *stream.EventPublisher, eventCh chan controller.Event) error {
    57		subscription, err := publisher.Subscribe(&stream.SubscribeRequest{
    58			Topic:   state.EventTopicExportedServices,
    59			Subject: stream.SubjectWildcard,
    60		})
    61		if err != nil {
    62			return err
    63		}
    64		defer subscription.Unsubscribe()
    65		var index uint64
    66	
    67		for {
    68			event, err := subscription.Next(ctx)
    69			switch {
    70			case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
    71				return nil
    72			case err != nil:
    73				return err
    74			}
    75	
    76			if event.IsFramingEvent() {
    77				continue
    78			}
    79	
    80			if event.Index <= index {
    81				continue
    82			}
    83	
    84			index = event.Index
    85			e := event.Payload.ToSubscriptionEvent(event.Index)
    86			configEntry := e.GetConfigEntry().GetConfigEntry()
    87	
    88			if configEntry.GetKind() != pbconfigentry.Kind_KindExportedServices {
    89				logger.Error("unexpected config entry kind", "kind", configEntry.GetKind())
    90				continue
    91			}
    92			partition := acl.PartitionOrDefault(configEntry.GetEnterpriseMeta().GetPartition())
    93	
    94			eventCh <- controller.Event{
    95				Obj: exportedServiceItemType{partition: partition},
    96			}
    97		}
    98	}

    50	func (r *FederationStateReplicator) fetchRemote(lastRemoteIndex uint64) (int, interface{}, uint64, error) {
    51		req := structs.DCSpecificRequest{
    52			Datacenter: r.srv.config.PrimaryDatacenter,
    53			QueryOptions: structs.QueryOptions{
    54				AllowStale:    true,
    55				MinQueryIndex: lastRemoteIndex,
    56				Token:         r.srv.tokens.ReplicationToken(),
    57			},
    58		}
    59	
    60		var response structs.IndexedFederationStates
    61		if err := r.srv.RPC(context.Background(), "FederationState.List", &req, &response); err != nil {
    62			return 0, nil, 0, err
    63		}
    64	
    65		states := []*structs.FederationState(response.States)
    66	
    67		return len(response.States), states, response.Index, nil
    68	}
    69	
    70	// FetchLocal implements IndexReplicatorDelegate.
    71	func (r *FederationStateReplicator) FetchLocal() (int, interface{}, error) {
    72		_, local, err := r.srv.fsm.State().FederationStateList(nil)
    73		if err != nil {
    74			return 0, nil, err
    75		}
    76	
    77		return len(local), local, nil
    78	}
    79	
    80	// DiffRemoteAndLocalState implements IndexReplicatorDelegate.
    81	func (r *FederationStateReplicator) DiffRemoteAndLocalState(localRaw interface{}, remoteRaw interface{}, lastRemoteIndex uint64) (*IndexReplicatorDiff, error) {
    82		local, ok := localRaw.([]*structs.FederationState)
    83		if !ok {
    84			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid type for local federation states: %T", localRaw)
    85		}
    86		remote, ok := remoteRaw.([]*structs.FederationState)
    87		if !ok {
    88			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid type for remote federation states: %T", remoteRaw)
    89		}
    90		federationStateSort(local)
    91		federationStateSort(remote)
    92	
    93		var deletions []*structs.FederationState
    94		var updates []*structs.FederationState
    95		var localIdx int
    96		var remoteIdx int
    97		for localIdx, remoteIdx = 0, 0; localIdx < len(local) && remoteIdx < len(remote); {
    98			if local[localIdx].Datacenter == remote[remoteIdx].Datacenter {
    99				// fedState is in both the local and remote state - need to check raft indices
   100				if remote[remoteIdx].ModifyIndex > lastRemoteIndex {
   101					updates = append(updates, remote[remoteIdx])
   102				}
   103				// increment both indices when equal
   104				localIdx += 1
   105				remoteIdx += 1
   106			} else if local[localIdx].Datacenter < remote[remoteIdx].Datacenter {
   107				// fedState no longer in remoted state - needs deleting
   108				deletions = append(deletions, local[localIdx])
   109	
   110				// increment just the local index
   111				localIdx += 1
   112			} else {
   113				// local state doesn't have this fedState - needs updating
   114				updates = append(updates, remote[remoteIdx])
   115	
   116				// increment just the remote index
   117				remoteIdx += 1
   118			}
   119		}

    26	// GatewayLocator assists in selecting an appropriate mesh gateway when wan
    27	// federation via mesh gateways is enabled.
    28	//
    29	// This is exclusively used by the consul server itself when it needs to tunnel
    30	// RPC or gossip through a mesh gateway to reach its ultimate destination.
    31	//
    32	// During secondary datacenter bootstrapping there is a phase where it is
    33	// impossible for mesh gateways in the secondary datacenter to register
    34	// themselves into the catalog to be discovered by the servers, so the servers
    35	// maintain references for the mesh gateways in the primary in addition to its
    36	// own local mesh gateways.
    37	//
    38	// After initial datacenter federation the primary mesh gateways are only used
    39	// in extreme fallback situations (basically re-bootstrapping).
    40	//
    41	// For all other operations a consul server will ALWAYS contact a local mesh
    42	// gateway to ultimately forward the request through a remote mesh gateway to
    43	// reach its destination.
    44	type GatewayLocator struct {
    45		logger            hclog.Logger
    46		srv               serverDelegate
    47		datacenter        string // THIS dc
    48		primaryDatacenter string
    49	
    50		// these ONLY contain ones that have the wanfed:1 meta
    51		gatewaysLock      sync.Mutex
    52		primaryGateways   []string // WAN addrs
    53		localGateways     []string // LAN addrs
    54		populatedGateways bool
    55	
    56		// primaryMeshGatewayDiscoveredAddresses is the current fallback addresses
    57		// for the mesh gateways in the primary datacenter.
    58		primaryMeshGatewayDiscoveredAddresses     []string
    59		primaryMeshGatewayDiscoveredAddressesLock sync.Mutex
    60	
    61		// This will be closed the FIRST time we get some gateways populated
    62		primaryGatewaysReadyCh   chan struct{}
    63		primaryGatewaysReadyOnce sync.Once
    64	
    65		// these are a collection of measurements that factor into deciding if we
    66		// should directly dial the primary's mesh gateways or if we should try to
    67		// route through our local gateways (if they are up).
    68		lastReplLock         sync.Mutex
    69		lastReplSuccess      time.Time
    70		lastReplFailure      time.Time
    71		lastReplSuccesses    uint64
    72		lastReplFailures     uint64
    73		useReplicationSignal bool // this should be set to true on the leader
    74	}
    75	
    76	// SetLastFederationStateReplicationError is used to indicate if the federation
    77	// state replication loop has succeeded (nil) or failed during the last
    78	// execution.
    79	//
    80	// Rather than introduce a completely new mechanism to periodically probe that
    81	// our chosen mesh-gateway configuration can reach the primary's servers (like
    82	// a ping or status RPC) we cheat and use the federation state replicator
    83	// goroutine's success or failure as a proxy.
    84	func (g *GatewayLocator) SetLastFederationStateReplicationError(err error, fromReplication bool) {
    85		if g == nil {
    86			return
    87		}
    88	
    89		g.lastReplLock.Lock()
    90		defer g.lastReplLock.Unlock()
    91	
    92		oldChoice := g.dialPrimaryThroughLocalGateway()
    93		if err == nil {
    94			g.lastReplSuccess = time.Now().UTC()
    95			g.lastReplSuccesses++
    96			g.lastReplFailures = 0
    97			if fromReplication {
    98				// If we get info from replication, assume replication is operating.
    99				g.useReplicationSignal = true
   100			}
   101		} else {
   102			g.lastReplFailure = time.Now().UTC()
   103			g.lastReplFailures++
   104			g.lastReplSuccesses = 0
   105		}
   106		newChoice := g.dialPrimaryThroughLocalGateway()
   107		if oldChoice != newChoice {
   108			g.logPrimaryDialingMessage(newChoice)
   109		}
   110	}
   111	
   112	func (g *GatewayLocator) SetUseReplicationSignal(newValue bool) {
   113		if g == nil {
   114			return
   115		}
   116	
   117		g.lastReplLock.Lock()
   118		g.useReplicationSignal = newValue
   119		g.lastReplLock.Unlock()
   120	}
